OFFER: 20% OFF your first acting headshot or showreel. All you need to do is…

Tag an actor friend in the comments below

Share this post to your story

Email ben@lensface.co.uk with the subject line ‘20% OFF’

This offer ends on the 15th of October.

Lensface is based in the North West of England.

Check out our services at [www.lensface.co.uk](http://www.lensface.co.uk/?fbclid=IwcGRvZgFleHRuA2FlbQIxMABzcnRjBmFwcF9pZBAyMjIwMzkxNzg4MjAwODkyAAEehbCHUG7BNMlL0aj4fgsgQ0EbevwYME6byQH6ylr41S5a7JsyV1J9lsSc3YI_aem_ZDFy4ng7HtgvGF82a2-f6A)

For bookings and enquiries email ben@lensface.co.uk

BRING A FRIEND AND SAVE MONEY

I offer a ‘Two-Friend Price Split’ option for most headshot sessions - This is ideal for a pair of actors wanting to split the cost of their headshots. Details on website (link above).

WHY CHOOSE LENSFACE?

Lensface creates the essential tools for actors seeking work: impactful headshots, effective showreel scenes and edited video showreels to demonstrate your strengths as a performer.

My name is Ben, I am an experienced photographer, actor, writer, director, producer and editor.

As a photographer, I create natural headshots that capture your unique look. 

As a writer, I build curated showreel scenes that highlight your strengths. 

As an actor and director, I help you give a performance you can be proud of. 

As an editor, I assemble scenes that show you at your best.

TESTIMONIALS

‘Really enjoyed my time with Ben. He really listened and understood the nature of the shots I wanted to get out of the day. He then knocked it out of the park. Thanks Ben. Looking forward to working with you again.’ - Dominic

‘Ben's work has been fantastic, both for headshots and showreel scenes. Behind the camera, he frames shots to make for a varied portfolio of headshots that draw your attention. For showreels, he makes sure to lend his video shooting and editing skills so nothing distracts from what's important, the performance. Thanks so much Ben!’ - Asa

‘Ben is absolutely the person to have in your corner. He has an incredible eye for detail, is supportive and reliable. He is fantastic when it comes to showreel scenes, from creating a great visual set up to giving direction.

Highly recommend!’ - Amy

‘Ben’s direction, attention to detail and range of technical skills mean that he can work the angles and work with you to get your best take.’ - Matty

Looking for Actors to read next week! 15th September @18:30 online! 

🇬🇭 ‘TANGLED ROOTS’ by Gladys Moore is a beautiful short play that flits between 1970’s Ghana and modern-day London:
‘Clasping to memories gone past while confusion and old age make it difficult to remember where home is.’
CHARACTER BREAKDOWN 🤩

GEORGE - Male (70’s but also appears in his 20’s in flashbacks), Ghanaian 
JENNIFER - Female, George’s daughter (small role), British/Ghanaian.
Richard - Male (20s), George’s friend. Ghanaian. 
Henry - Male (Teenager), British/Ghanaian from London.

Check out the post for more information to join in!

sharedPost.text:
It's been a truly amazing experience exploring some extraordinary new scripts destined for the stage this summer! For our last reading of the series, we have not one but two scripts to delve into. ❤️

First up, we have an intriguing new play about the very first algorithm that will have you on your feet with anticipation. 'Paper Human' by the very talented Stephen Connolly follows two female civil servants. One in Holland in 1941, the other in France in 1943. They plan to break into Government offices and destroy their contents: the millions of IBM punch cards bearing demographic details of their fellow citizens.

We are also delighted to introduce you to the beautiful writings of Gladys Moore and her wonderful new short script, 'Tangled Roots'. It follows the story of George, an elderly, proud Ghanaian man fighting to maintain his independence as his memory begins to betray him. A chance meeting with Henry, a young British Ghanaian, sparks a connection through music and shared history.  

🎭So join us for R Online Read - DOUBLE BILL! 
 
📅 Taking place online on the 15th of September at 6:30 PM (BST).
 
💻 To learn more and book your spot to read or listen to some fantastic new theatre—click the link below now!

https://www.rcreatives.co.uk/event-details-registration/34-paper-human-by-stephen-connolly-tangled-roots-by-gladys-moore

#Rcreatives

Hey, ich bin Kerem, 18 Jahre alt und angehender Schauspieler aus dem Ruhrgebiet. Ich bin aktuell auf der Suche nach Regisseuren und Filmschaffenden in NRW, mit denen ich spannende Kurzfilmprojekte realisieren kann.

Ich habe bereits in drei Kurzfilmen mitgespielt und bin immer auf der Suche nach neuen Möglichkeiten, vor der Kamera zu arbeiten und gemeinsam kreative Projekte umzusetzen.

Ich habe außerdem etwas zu Kurzfilmfestivals recherchiert und bin dabei auf die Internationalen Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen und das KFFK „Battle of the Shorts“ gestoßen:

https://www.kurzfilmtage.de/de/festival/einreichung/

https://www.kffk.de/battle-of-the-shorts/

Vielleicht hast du ja selbst schon länger eine Idee für einen Kurzfilm oder hättest Lust, gemeinsam etwas auf die Beine zu stellen. Gerade ein Projekt mit dem Ziel, es anschließend bei passenden Festivals einzureichen, fände ich sehr spannend.

Falls du grundsätzlich Interesse an einer Zusammenarbeit hast, würde ich mich sehr über einen Austausch freuen! 🙌

LG
Kerem

Filmmakers: https://www.filmmakers.eu/de/actors/kerem-dag
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/keremdg_?igsi=OWgxdTdkZWs2b3J6&utm_source=qr

Für einen sehr kleinen, humorvollen Werbefilm suchen wir noch **Nachwuchs- oder Laienschauspieler:innen/ spannende Persönlichkeiten** im Alter von 35 - 50 Jahren.

Schauspielerfahrung ist von Vorteil, aber keinesfalls notwendig. Viel wichtiger sind uns interessante Persönlichkeiten mit einer starken Ausstrahlung, die Interesse und Lust auf Film und/ oder neuen Herausforderungen haben.

**Drehort: Nürnberg **

**Drehtag: 09.10.26 oder 11.10.26.**

Da es sich um ein sehr kleines Projekt handelt, kann die Produktion leider nur eine **Aufwandsentschädigung von bis zu 300,- für den Drehtag **anbieten, ohne Reisekosten.

Wenn ihr euch angesprochen fühlt, freuen wir uns über eine Nachricht mit einem Foto und ein paar Infos zu euch an folgende E-Mail: thaikevinpilz@gmail.com

**Drehort: Nürnberg **

**Drehtag: 09.10.26 oder 11.10.26.**

Da es sich um ein sehr kleines Projekt handelt, kann die Produktion leider nur eine **Aufwandsentschädigung von bis zu 300,- für den Drehtag **anbieten, ohne Reisekosten.

Wenn ihr euch angesprochen fühlt, freuen wir uns über eine Nachricht mit einem Foto und ein paar Infos zu euch an folgende E-Mail: thaikevinpilz@gmail.com

LOS ANGELES AUDITIONS FOR Norwegian Cruise Line 

Norwegian Cruise Line is seeking VOCALISTS and DANCERS for the all-new productions aboard NCL's newest ship, the Norwegian AURA.

**DANCERS - September 19, 2026**
*Open Call. No pre-registration required. Talent will be seen in the order in which they arrive.*

**Sign-In: **9:30am
**Start:** 10:00am

**LOCATION**
Mihran K. Studios
135 N Victory Blvd
Burbank, CA 91502 

Female-identifying performers, please be prepared to dance in both heels and flats. Male-identifying dancers should bring sneakers and jazz shoes. Bring a hard copy of your headshot and resume. All dancers should wear form-fitting dance attire and be prepared to learn multiple combos. Callbacks will be held the same afternoon.

**SPECIALTY VOCALISTS & PRODUCTION SINGERS - September 20, 2026**
****By Appointment Only****

To be considered for an appointment, please have your representation submit via Breakdown Services, submit yourself via Actors Access or submit via **vocalists.castingcrane.com**

Selected applicants will receive an email with audition location, audition time, and additional audition details.

**CONTRACT DETAILS:**
Creative Team: Kevin & Marcel Wilson
Rehearsals begin on or about November 9, 2026 for Dancers
Holiday Break: December 20, 2026 – January 10, 2027
Rehearsal Resumes: January 11, 2027 For Dancers
Rehearsals begin on or about January 11, 2027 for Specialty Vocalists
Rehearsals begin on or about February 8, 2027 for Singers
Board the Norwegian AURA on or about February 22, 2027
End of contract TBD 6-7 months onboard
Itinerary: Mediterranean and Caribbean
***All dates subject to change.***

SPECIALTY VOCALISTS: $1,730/week ($7,500/month) onboard
SINGERS: $1,200/week ($5,200/month) onboard
DANCERS: $1,000/week ($4,350/month) onboard  

Travel will be provided to Tampa for rehearsal, to the ship, and home at the end of the contract. Cast members will be provided with a single occupancy cabin onboard (including dancers). Cast will be Crew Members with no cruise staff duties outside of the performance schedule. 

Please visit the link below for more information:

[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html)

Hi all, we're running a clothing fitting session tomorrow at a photography studio in Belgravia (5 mins from Victoria station) and we're after a few specific body types. You'll try on a selection of clothes and be photographed in each outfit so we can review how they fit. It's about the clothes, not you, so no modelling experience needed, you just stand there. Small friendly team, professional studio, relaxed session.

£75 for around two hours, time slot confirmed today.

UPDATE 

Women - average build both tall & short l

Please message me your height, your weight and a full length photo so we can check the fit before confirming. If someone arrives on the day and isn't the size they told us, unfortunately we won't be able to go ahead and won't be able to pay for the session, so please only apply if you're a genuine match.

Message me and I'll confirm your slot and send the details today.

Thanks!

Zwei unglaubliche Konzerte 🎶von TRAIN45, die es in sich hatten; nicht zuletzt auch und gerade wegen des begeisterten Leeraner Publikums. Auch sie vollführten so manchen „summer jump“! 
Wir Musiker 🪕🎙️🎻🎸sind noch total 💯 geflasht, hin und weg 🤩 und heel over‘t stüür!!!
Auch Jolina Carl, die ja Ende Nov. hier im Kulturspeicher Leer gemeinsam mit Sievert Ahrend mit deren neu gegründetem Duo Mr. JoSie ihre Live- Premiere bei Mr.JoSie‘s Country Christmas geben wird, war mehr als beeindruckt! Schön, dass du dich persönlich vorgestellt hast, Jolina! ♥️
Vielen herzlichen Dank 🙏🏽 für so viel Hilfe und Unterstützung an all die lieben Menschen von: Hibben (Vorverkauf), Presse 🗞️, Kulturspeicher bzw. Stadtbibliothek Leer, Maike (50er Wohnzimmer), Michaela vom Genussreich (Bewirtung) und an Anja 😘für die ganze Organisation. An Frank Ammermann von der Rheiderland Zeitung 📰 für die superschönen Photos (Bericht folgt): Toll, dass du dir die Zeit genommen hast, Frank! 
Unser besonderer Dank geht diesmal an die Leeraner Feuerwehrleute 👩‍🚒, die schon vorher lange bei einem Großbrand 🔥 im Einsatz waren! Enorm, was ihr leistet!!!
Und last but not least an unser tolles Leeraner Publikum: Ihr seid Spitzenklasse!!! 👏🏼 🙌 

#summerjump #train45 #kulturspeicherleer #50erjahremusik #countrymusic rockabilly

👉Poszukuję pracy dorywczej/zleceń weekendowych (Eventy/Kierowca/Konferansjer)💪

Witam!

Szukam dodatkowych zleceń i pracy dorywczej w weekendy (piątek-niedziela). Jestem dojrzałym (49lat), postawnym (190cm wzrostu) i odpowiedzialnym mężczyzną o wysokiej kulturze osobistej🙂

W czym mogę pomóc/moje doświadczenie i predyspozycje:

👉 Kierowca/ Przewóz VIP: posiadam prawo jazdy kat. B (wieloletnie doświadczenie za kierownicą), dyskrecję, nienaganne maniery oraz dbam o reprezentacyjny wygląd;

👉Prowadzenie wydarzeń (Konferansjer/Spiker sportowy/Prowadzący): dobra dykcja, swoboda wypowiedzi przed mikrofonem i publicznością, opanowanie i energia na scenie;

👉Obsługa eventów, imprez i targów: wsparcie logistyczne, koordynacja gości, obsługa techniczna/organizacja wydarzeń.

Cechuje mnie punktualność, wysoka etyka pracy i szybkie dostosowanie się do potrzeb organizatora😊

Zainteresowane osoby zapraszam do kontaktu w wiadomości prywatnej (messenger) - chętnie omówię szczegóły👍

**NOWY SERIAL KRYMINALNY – RUSZAMY Z CASTINGIEM!**

Już 29 września wchodzimy na plan z zupełnie nowym projektem! Szykuje się mocny,

trzymający w napięciu serial kryminalny, którego dynamiczna akcja rozgrywa się w ciągu

zaledwie trzech dni. Mrożące krew w żyłach historie i profiler próbujący za wszelką cenę

namierzyć przestępcę – to będzie prawdziwy rollercoaster! 

Już teraz rozpoczynamy poszukiwania (statystów), którzy wcielą się w role policjantów z kontynuacją.

Panowie 20 -50 lat

**Co warto wiedzieć?**

 Terminy: Będziemy kontaktować się indywidualnie w sprawie konkretnych dni

zdjęciowych.

 Kolejne role: Bliżej terminów rozpoczęcia zdjęć będziemy szukać również

epizodystów do ról petentów, ale nie tylko

Zgłoszenia poproszę na adres:** jarek.drzycimski@podtytulem.pl**

ZDJĘCIE TWARZY - portretowe selfie w dziennym świetle, na wprost, patrząc w obiektyw.

Bez żadnych filtrów. Bez okularów. Bez nakrycia głowy. Kolorowe.

ZDJĘCIE SYLWETKI – aktualne, cała sylwetka. Bez osób towarzyszących.

CASTING CALL:
Title: The Art of Making Mistakes

Genre: Drama, Comedy, Student film. 

Logline: The Art of Making Mistakes is a dark comedy that centers on an over productive father, who’s worked hard to provide for his family, and his son, who’s faced the consequences of his absence.

CHARACTERS:

Larry (Early 30s, Hispanic): A machismo father who has spent his whole life building a home for his wife and son, only to realize he’s never actually had time to live in it. Brash. Stuck in his ways.

Xavier (8–12, Hispanic): A young boy forced to write his school report on his macho, enigmatic father. Curious and stubborn. Questions others as much as he questions himself. Where he goes, trouble follows.

Tom (Any race, 40s-50s): A machismo boss at a construction company. Distances himself from co-workers to avoid attachment. Utterly professional. A straight shooter.

Maria (Early 30s, Hispanic): An old-school Hispanic mother. Fiercely protective. The only thread keeping her family intact. Understands that forgiveness and discipline are a balancing act.

Shooting will take place within late October and early November. Filming for 4 to 5 days on the Westminster, CO and Denver, CO area. 

We will provide a meal every day; there will also be snacks and drinks. Once post-production is complete, those involved in the project will be given access to the short film. 

Self-tapes will be available; keep an eye out for the next post!

Email david.renteria@ucdenver.edu for more information.

items.text:
PAID OPPORTUNITY – PRESENTER / BIG PERSONALITY WANTED – LIVERPOOL, SUNDAY 13TH SEPTEMBER

We’re looking for a confident, outgoing personality to represent Bret’s Shave Cream at The Great British Barber Bash in Liverpool this Sunday.

£175 for around 4–5 hours.

This is NOT a “stand behind an exhibition table” job.

We want someone who can work the room, approach barbers, start conversations, have a laugh and create entertaining content with us.

You’ll be given challenges throughout the day, such as:

* Interview barbers around the show
* Walk up to strangers and introduce them to Bret’s
* Present barbers with our shave cream and get their reaction
* Get brutally honest opinions on camera
* Challenge people to try the product
* Ask funny and interesting questions
* Find the biggest personalities in the room
* Create some mischief and buzz around Bret’s
* Help us capture loads of genuine social-media content

You won’t be filming. We’ll have a camera person following you and capturing the interactions.

We’re not particularly bothered about qualifications or a huge following.

You might be a presenter, actor, comedian, content creator, TikToker, salesperson — or simply someone ridiculously confident who can walk into a room full of strangers and get people talking.

You don’t need to know anything about shaving or barbering. We’ll brief you and give you the challenges.

📍 Liverpool
📅 Sunday 13th September
⏱ Approx. 4–5 hours
💰 £175

Think you’d smash it?

DM @bretsdotcom with a quick 30-second video introducing yourself and tell us where you’re based.

Your mission: make Bret’s impossible to ignore.

items.text:
Casting Call
I am a producer on a graduate horror/drama short film in Ripon, with support from the local council and business', with a multi-award winning director attached. The story follows a young girl, who lost her face in an accident, as she struggles with her emotions as she tries to reconnect with society and her own overprotective father.

Character 1- Warren

Character synopsis - We are looking to cast the role of Warren (18-25) , a homeless drug addict, a small but important role. They are the mirror image of the central character, abandoned and confined to the darkness of the alleyways, yet when faced with a similar individual they lash out, out of fear and distrust, becoming the very thing they hated most. Despite their small screen time they have a lasting presence in the story.

We will be filming this scene the night of the 15th of September in Ripon and expenses will be paid for. This includes travel and food. 

Unfortunately because we are a small budget production we can only pay expenses and cannot pay a daily or hourly rate.

Character 2- Bouncer

We are looking to cast the role of the bouncer, a short but important role that brings a much needed ounce of comedy into an otherwise dark film. He is a man of large build but a heart of gold, who tries to find what fun he can in his long cold night shift.

We will be filming this scene the night of the 16th of September in Ripon and expenses will be paid for. This includes travel and food. 

Unfortunately because we are a small budget production we can only pay expenses and cannot pay a daily or hourly rate.

If you are interested please send an email to kurt.sear@gmail.com with a sizzle reel/headshots.

Casting Call
I am a producer on a graduate horror/drama short film in Ripon, with support from the local council and business', with a multi-award winning director attached. The story follows a young girl, who lost her face in an accident, as she struggles with her emotions as she tries to reconnect with society and her own overprotective father.

Character 1- Warren

Character synopsis - We are looking to cast the role of Warren (18-25) , a homeless drug addict, a small but important role. They are the mirror image of the central character, abandoned and confined to the darkness of the alleyways, yet when faced with a similar individual they lash out, out of fear and distrust, becoming the very thing they hated most. Despite their small screen time they have a lasting presence in the story.

We will be filming this scene the night of the 15th of September in Ripon and expenses will be paid for. This includes travel and food. 

Unfortunately because we are a small budget production we can only pay expenses and cannot pay a daily or hourly rate.

Character 2- Bouncer

We are looking to cast the role of the bouncer, a short but important role that brings a much needed ounce of comedy into an otherwise dark film. He is a man of large build but a heart of gold, who tries to find what fun he can in his long cold night shift.

We will be filming this scene the night of the 16th of September in Ripon and expenses will be paid for. This includes travel and food. 

Unfortunately because we are a small budget production we can only pay expenses and cannot pay a daily or hourly rate.

If you are interested please send an email to kurt.sear@gmail.com with a sizzle reel/headshots.

Do filmu historycznego osadzonego w XIX wieku szukamy mężczyzn w różnym wieku i o różnym wyglądzie.

📅 ZDJĘCIA: 16.09 | Warszawa
📅 PRZYMIARKI: 09.09 | Mokotów
🕐 Godziny przymiarek – do wyboru, w godzinach popołudniowych.

🌙 Wejdziemy w zdjęcia nocne.

💰 STAWKA: 240 zł netto – łącznie z przymiarką
💵 PŁATNOŚĆ: gotówką po zdjęciach

Szukamy zarówno mężczyzn o charakterystycznej urodzie, jak i osób o bardziej naturalnym, surowym wyglądzie.

⚠️ Wcześniej projekt Pauliny- osoby, które nie brały jeszcze udziału 

📩 ZGŁOSZENIA:
juliacast.kontakt@gmail.com

TYTUŁ MAILA: 16.09

W mailu proszę podać:
• imię i nazwisko
• wiek
• wzrost
• numer telefonu
• informację o tatuażach
• informację o aparacie ortodontycznym
• preferowaną godzinę przymiarki

📸 Koniecznie aktualne zdjęcia:
• twarz
• cała sylwetka
• fryzura z boku
• fryzura od tyłu

items.text:
hey all, anyone have any advice on how to get into the scene with pretty nonexistent production background experience, but a film education/BFA?

having a hard time getting anyone to give me the time of day since I've been out of the film world for so long. I'm very willing to do even unpaid work but it seems like because I had to go to corporate for ten years, people look at my resume and turn me away even though those skills are very easily transferrable. 

I have worked on a couple indie sets, but back in '17. i'm trying to finally get out of corporate and i moved out to LA thinking it'd be easier get on even just a small set, but it's been months and no one has given me even the smallest of shots, i don't even know how many PA roles I've applied to now.

Any tips?

topComments.text: Agreed with Bennetts question. I often see some people I’ve hired as background working as costume, PAs, Production Coordinators etc on subsequent shows for other shows that the same company produces

CHAPMAN UNIVERSITY THESIS FILM CASTING CALL

PARENTS SUBSTITUTE — Comedy/Drama

Logline: After getting into serious trouble at school, an international high schooler hires two strangers to pose as his parents for a disciplinary meeting, only for the lie to become increasingly difficult to control.

Shoot Dates: Oct. 2–4 & Oct. 9–11, 2026

Location: Orange County / Chapman University area

Auditions: Self-tape, callbacks if needed

NON-UNION ONLY. SAG-AFTRA / union performers cannot be considered.

JUSTIN — Lead, Male, 18, East Asian. Rebellious and emotionally guarded, Justin uses sarcasm and makes impulsive decisions to avoid facing the consequences of his actions. Beneath his detached attitude lies a deep fear of disappointing his family and of being forced to admit he is struggling. Seeking strong deadpan comedic timing and subtle dramatic range. Pay: $150/day, est. 6 days / $900 total.

PRINCIPAL ANDERSON — Supporting, Male, 40-60, any ethnicity. A stern and intimidating school administrator with very dry humor. Seeking strong authority and understated comedic timing. Pay: $150/day, est. 4 days / $600 total.

MIA — Supporting, Female, 40s, any ethnicity. Glamorous, confident, unpredictable stranger hired to pose as Justin’s mother. Strong comedic timing and expressive screen presence. Pay: $150/day, est. 3 days / $450 total.

TOM — Supporting, Male, 40s, any ethnicity. Rough, awkward Uber driver hired to pose as Justin’s father. Seeking natural deadpan comedy with warmth underneath. Pay: $150/day, est. 3 days / $450 total.

RYAN — Supporting, Male, 20s, any ethnicity. Justin’s social, easygoing, casually chaotic roommate and friend. Natural comedic timing and relaxed charisma. Unpaid; meals, copy, and credit provided.

AI NOTICE: This production will use AI-generated and/or AI-assisted visual elements during post-production/VFX. Additional details will be provided to selected performers before signing.

TO SUBMIT: Email zmao@chapman.edu with subject “PARENTS SUBSTITUTE — [ROLE] — [NAME]” and include headshot, résumé, reel if available, current location, availability for the shoot dates, and confirmation that you are non-union.

🎬 CASTING CALL — THE SITE
PILOT EPISODE
A COLD UP NORTH FILMS PRODUCTION
📅 FRIDAY 18TH SEPTEMBER 2026
⏰ 2PM–7PM
📍 THE CLEVELAND HOTEL, CRUMPSALL, MANCHESTER, M8
🎥 ABOUT THE SITE
The Site is a new crime comedy-drama set in Manchester and the North of England, following the Cash family, a travelling family balancing their traditional way of life with the wider community around them.
A diverse, character-driven story featuring crime, comedy, drama and everyday situations, with strong Northern characters and plenty of unexpected twists.
We're looking for actors who can deliver both comedy and serious drama, as well as performers from all backgrounds.
🔞 RATED 15 — Contains strong language, scenes of a violent nature and mature themes.
🎭 ROLES
👮‍♀️ Female Police Officer — Female, 18–30
💰 Tommy Cash Jr — Male, 18–30
👩 Ellie Cash — Female, 18–30
👩 Bernie Cash — Female, 40–50
🔪 Local Street Villains x2 — Male, 18–30
🤝 Charlie, Simo's Right-Hand Man — Male, 25–35
🎪 SITE CHARACTERS — Boys & girls, 16–30
🎬 EXTRAS — All ages & backgrounds
🇮🇪 IRISH ACCENT?
Can you do a convincing Irish accent? Not essential, but appreciated for certain roles.
🎬 OPEN AUDITION — JUST TURN UP!
No application needed. Come along on the day and audition.
🪪 Please bring identification.
Anyone under 16 must attend with an appropriate adult.
Previous acting experience isn't essential — we're looking for new talent, experienced actors and people with the right personality for the roles.
🎥 THE SITE
Written & Directed by Brian Walters
Filmed by Rush Walker
Archie Valerio
A Cold Up North Films Production
🔥 CASTING NOW OPEN
THE CASHES. THEIR FAMILY. THEIR COMMUNITY. THEIR WAY OF LIFE.
CRIME • COMEDY • DRAMA • REAL LIFE.

items.text:
PAID Opportunity: $200 - $400 per role depending on experience and role

·       Tucson 1 day someday September 22–30, 2026

 

**Alcohol Compliance Check Training Videos**

Female or male, plays 30s–40s, reads as an experienced, credible law-enforcement professional. Reyes works the inside of each location — positioned with a clear sightline to the point of sale, blending in as an ordinary customer until it's time to identify herself. When she does make contact with a clerk or bartender, she is quiet, procedural, and never confrontational.

·       Look: professional, plainclothes-appropriate — no uniform needed for the audition.

 

How to Audition — Self-Tape

We're accepting self-tape auditions. No in-person callback is required at this stage.

·       Frame yourself from the chest up, horizontal (landscape) video. A phone camera is fine.

·       Use even, front-facing light on your face — avoid strong backlight (e.g., a window behind you).

·       Record somewhere quiet with minimal echo. Clear audio matters as much as picture.

·       Start with a brief slate: say your name, the role you're reading for, and confirm your general availability September 23–30, 2026.

·       Read the side(s) for your role naturally — memorization isn't required. You can read off a print or phone held just outside the lens, but keep your eyes as close to camera as you comfortably can on key lines.

·       One or two takes per side is plenty. Send your best take, not every take.

 

SIDE A — IDENTIFYING HERSELF AFTER A SALE

*Calm, low-key authority. No raised voice, no theatrics — this should feel almost anticlimactic.*

OFFICER REYES:  Good evening, sir. Officer Reyes with the Police Department. It appears you made a mistake and sold alcohol to a minor. I'll need to see your ID.

SIDE B — CLOSING OUT A CLEAN REFUSAL

*Warmer and quicker — this clerk did everything right, and Reyes' tone should reflect that.*

OFFICER REYES:  Police Department. He's with us on a compliance check. We appreciate you checking IDs. I'll take that, and we'll be out of your way.

 

What to Submit

·       Your self-tape (as a file attachment, or a shareable link — Google Drive, Dropbox, or an unlisted YouTube link all work)

·       A current photo (a clear selfie is fine — we're checking look and age range, not headshot polish)

·       A resume or reel link, if you have one (not required)

·       Your name, phone number, and confirmation of availability across September 22–30, 2026

Email everything to [Taylor@FinancialPotion.com](mailto:Taylor@FinancialPotion.com) with the subject line “[Role Name] — [Your Name] — Compliance Check Casting” by end of day Saturday, September 12th.

Paid  $200 - $400 per role depending on experience and role

 

Recording in Tucson Approx. September 22, 2026 (may shift a few days within Sept 23–30 — please confirm availability across that full window)

items.text:
# **Looking to Connect: Short Documentary**

Hi everyone,

I’m not sure if this is exactly a crew/cast call, but you can consider it to be one, I guess.

I’m an MFA filmmaking student based in Wilmington, NC, currently working on my thesis, which is a short documentary about **AI data centers**.

I imagine the first question that might come to mind is: *“Okay… is this film for data centers or against them?”* Honestly, I don’t know yet…and that’s kind of the point. I’m still learning and realizing how much I don’t know about these places and the systems that operate around them.

So I’d love to talk to anyone who has some experience, knowledge, curiosity, or even just thoughts about data centers, AI infrastructure, or the subject in general.

I am also looking for collaborators who can help me with logistics and shoots. If you're someone interested in **producing**, **sound**, or **camera**, please connect.

If that sounds like something you’d be interested in talking about, **please DM me. I’d genuinely love to hear from you.**

Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, dein Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 37/2026

HEXENTIME, ORIGIN STORY UND 20 JAHRE LIGHTNING MC QUEEN 

Die Owens-Schwestern ﻿﻿Sally (Sandra Bullock) und Gillian (Nicole Kidman) müssen sich dem dunklen Fluch stellen, der ihre Familie ein für alle Mal zu vernichten droht. Ob Practical Magic 2 fast 30 Jahre nach dem Erstling verzaubert, erzählt Ihnen Sarah Fuchs.

The Uprising – Für die Freiheit“ ist ein kommender historischer Action-Thriller von Regisseur Paul Greengrass, der den Kinos startet. Der Film dramatisiert den englischen Bauernaufstand (Peasants’ Revolt) von 1381 gegen die Tyrannei von König Richard II.. Der Film dient insgeheim als eine Art Origin-Story für die legendäre Figur Robin Hood. Ob es tatsächlich einer weiteren Variante dieses Themas bedarf, erfahren Sie in unserer Sendung.

La tre Vita - Die drei Leben nennt sich der neueste Kurzfilm vom Pulkautaler Filmemacher Benjamin Baumgartner.  Wie der Film entstanden ist, worauf er basiert usw. erzählte er unserer Moderatorin im Gespräch. Ebenso durften wir mit Leonhard Pill anlässlich seiner neuesten Doku MUSS DAS PFERD AUCH ARBEITEN ein Interview führen.

Anlässlich des 20jährigen Anniversary von CARS bringen wir Auszüge aus dem Soundtrack aus 2006.

Mittwoch 9.9.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

namierzyć przestępcę – to będzie prawdziwy rollercoaster! 

Już teraz rozpoczynamy poszukiwania (statystów), którzy wcielą się w role policjantów z kontynuacją.

Panie i Panowie 20 -50 lat

zdjęciowych.

epizodystów do ról petentów, ale nie tylko

W tytule: **POLICJANT KONT **

**W treści:** imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, miejscowość

Bez żadnych filtrów. Bez okularów. Bez nakrycia głowy. Kolorowe.

ZDJĘCIE SYLWETKI – aktualne, cała sylwetka. Bez osób towarzyszących.

**CASTING CALL — Do you have a loved one in the UK? **

We're making a short documentary-style film about the food we miss when the people we love are far from home. We're not looking for actors. We're looking for a real family, Black/ Coloured/ Indian. Must be available for shoot dates in Early October

You might be right for this if:
* You have a grown child, sibling or parent living in the **United Kingdom (Including Ireland/ Scottland/ Whales)**
* You know what their life over there actually looks like — the work, the hours, the city
* There's a dish only you make properly, the one they always ask for. Bobotie. Melktert. Koeksisters. Umngqusho. Breyani. Your trifle, the one the family still argues about.
* You'd be comfortable being yourself on camera

**One important thing: this is a surprise.** Please don't mention it to your person in the UK — not a call, not a message, not a hint. If they find out, we can't use the story.

We're casting a South African family of colour (Black, Coloured or Indian). The selected family is professionally remunerated, and everything you send us is treated as confidential.

**Interested?** WhatsApp me a **voicenote or a short video** telling me:
1. Who your person is, and where they are in the UK
2. **What they do over there, and how long they've been there**
3. The dish they miss most — and why only you can make it right

📲 **0834563341 - This must reach me no later than 8 September**

I'll send you the full brief and a short questionnaire from there.

*Please share this with someone it might fit — just not with the person in the UK.*

Hey Ottawa Filmmakers! 

I’m looking for a few crew members to volunteer for my short film project (if enough funds are raised each volunteer will receive an honorarium 🤞🏼) and food, credit and gas reimbursment will definitely be provided - if available and interested, please email your materials to: claudiajurtpictures@gmail.com

PS as this is a small production, some of the crew positions may be doubled up 

Film: THE PB & J CONUNDRUM
Director: Claudia Jurt
Cinematographer: Geghani Panosian
Cast: Joshua Odjick (The Long Walk, IT: Welcome to Derry, Wildhood, Bon Cop, Bad Cop series, Little Bird, etc) & Joy Ruano

Date: Sunday, September 13, 2026
Location: Casselman, ON
Time: 8:00am-7:00pm (tentative)

Crew Members Needed:

Production Assistant 

Key Hair/Make-up - for an Indigenous male (20’s) and a 6.5 year old Indigenous girl (no make up for her, hair only - both have long hair 

Key Wardrobe 

Drone Operator - must come with camera to shoot overhead of farm property when yellow school bus arrives

Craft Services 

Stills Photographer

Props 

Art Director/Set Deck - one of the key things here are peanut butter and jelly jars with created labels 

1st Assistant Director 

Sound Recordist 

Our shooting location is approximately 40-60min east of Ottawa depending on which part of town you’re coming from - we also may have transportation available for a few people 

Thank you and look forward to hearing from you!

Best wishes,
Claudia

Die Komparsen- & Kleindarstelleragentur DU BIST FILM sucht DICH für Spielfilmdreharbeiten im Raum Freiburg im Breisgau!

Gesucht werden Komparsen & Kleindarsteller aber auch Straßenabsperrer und Parkplatzwächter, die das Team hinter der Kamera unterstützen. Gedreht wird ein 90 min Spielfilm.

📍 Drehorte: in/um 79362 Forchheim, 79350 Sexau, Breisach am Rhein, Nimburger Baggersee.
📆 Drehtage: 14.09 bis 18.09. (du musst nicht an allen Drehtagen Zeit haben)
🕓Uhrzeit: jew. Immer ganztägig
💸Gage: vergütet

Du hast Zeit und Lust teilzunehmen? Dann bewirb dich per E-Mail an info@komparse.tv unter Angabe von Name, Handynr., Wohnort, sowie aktuellen Fotos. Alle Infos zur Agentur findest du unter www.komparse.tv

Gerne weitersagen – vielleicht kennt jemand in deinem Umfeld genau die richtige Person!

Wir freuen uns auf dich!
Dein DU BIST FILM Team

#komparse #kleindarsteller #dubistfilm #gerneweitersagen💃

Kraków, szukam aktorów do spektaklu

Do spektaklu niezależnej grupy teatralnej poszukuję aktorów (niekoniecznie profesjonalnych), którzy wcielą się w drugoplanowe, epizodyczne role:
* młodego Żyda - Jakuba
* młodej Żydówki - Racheli (potrzebuję do tej roli śpiewającej dziewczyny)
* niemieckiego żołnierza - Jurgena

Spektakl oparty na literaturze z czasów II wojny światowej. Przewidziana premiera - listopad 2026. Próby raz w tygodniu w Krakowie. Projekt z gatunku raczej non-profit, ale nie wiadomo, gdzie nas pokrętne losy mogą poprowadzić. Zainteresowanych zapraszam na priv i dziękuję.

🎭 NOWY SEZON. NOWY REPERTUAR. I WRESZCIE MOŻEMY WAM GO POKAZAĆ! 🔥

Koniec tajemnic — przed Wami repertuar Pomorskiego Teatru Nobilis na październik 2026 – styczeń 2027. ❤️

A będzie się działo!

📸 „Najczulsze fotografie” – nasza najnowsza premiera. Spektakl, którego bohaterką będzie twórczość AGNIESZKI OSIECKIEJ. 
🕵️ „Plagiat” – komedia kryminalna wraca na scenę
⭐ „Mamy problem!” – monodram Magdaleny Bochan-Jachimek
😂 „Dwanaście scen z życia Matki” – komedia, która nadal nie zamierza dać matkom spokoju

Jednym słowem: jesień i zima zdecydowanie nie będą nudne. 😏

🎟️ BILETY JUŻ W SPRZEDAŻY!

👉 online przez KupBilecik.pl
👉 stacjonarnie w MDK Rumia

A teraz mamy znacznie ważniejsze pytanie:

👇 NA CO IDZIECIE PIERWSZE?

Piszcie w komentarzach — jesteśmy bardzo ciekawi, który tytuł wygra pierwszy wyścig o Waszą uwagę. ❤️

POMORSKI TEATR NOBILIS
Teatr, który łączy ludzi.

Casting : "Maybe its love, Maybe not"
WANTED !!!!!
I am Thomas Goersch from Stuttgart, Germany. 
Actor and Filmdirector. 
I am a director of Independent Movies.
I present my movies on International Film festivals and was lucky to receive some awards. 
But the work is not about awards and money, its about making movies for the people to think about.
My next movie is a modern love story:
An elderly man is meeting another younger, very attractive man in the Internet. But they are from different Continents. They start a long distance relastionship ship. which is full of passion and desire. 
One day the younger man starts to ask for money, cause he is a Student and no more able to pay his bills. 
The older man is full of distrust.
Is he only there to pay his lovers bills or is there love between them ?
A story with two endings.

URGENT
PAID: £75 for 2 hours, Belgravia, London, TOMORROW

Hi all, we're running a clothing fitting session tomorrow at a photography studio in Belgravia (5 mins from Victoria station) and we're after a few specific body types. You'll try on a selection of clothes and be photographed in each outfit so we can review how they fit. It's about the clothes, not you, so no modelling experience needed, you just stand there. Small friendly team, professional studio, relaxed session.

£75 for around two hours, time slot confirmed today.

UPDATE 

Women - average build both tall & short l

Also PLUS size 

Because it's all about how the clothes sit, we do need people to genuinely match these sizes. Please message me your height, your weight and a full length photo so we can check the fit before confirming. If someone arrives on the day and isn't the size they told us, unfortunately we won't be able to go ahead and won't be able to pay for the session, so please only apply if you're a genuine match.

Message me and I'll confirm your slot and send the details today.

Thanks!

🎬 CASTING CALL - FEATURE FILM
THE EIGHT SAGA: N.E.S.T PROJECT
We are casting MORRIGAN - Head of Science (30s-50s), a fantastic, complex role for an actress looking for something they can really get their teeth into.
Intelligent, sophisticated and unnervingly calm, Morrigan’s faith in science and progress develops into an obsession with control. We’re looking for a strong actress who can bring authority, intelligence and subtle menace to the role.
This is an unpaid passion project, with IMDb credit intended and festival ambitions including Cannes submission. It’s a substantial dramatic role and an opportunity to become part of a growing creative team and potential future projects.
TO APPLY:
Please send your headshot, Spotlight link and/or showreel, acting CV and current location to:
info@majesticacademyofperformingarts.co.uk
Please share or tag someone who could bring Morrigan to life.

#CastingCall #UKCasting #ActorsUK #FeatureFilm #FilmCasting #IndependentFilm #MajesticTalent #CastingUK

**Seeking Actors for Hollow Hills Night, a short film about a group of mid twenty year olds who find themselves face to face with demons and death. **

**HOLLOW HILLS NIGHT CASTING CALL:**

**Seeking Actors for Hollow Hills Night, a short film about a group of mid twenty year olds who find themselves face to face with demons and death. **

**KOLE** (mid 20s, butch presenting/ non-binary, serious when they need to be, street smart, but not smart smart)

**ARIANA **(mid 20s severely dejected the majority of the time, loves her friends, and has a dry sense of humor)

**MASON** (mid 20s, queer, bubbly personality, fairly offline – doesn’t know what’s going on in the world kind of offline)

**COREY** (mid 20s, a slightly airheaded whimsical hippy who is always ready to help out her friends and have a good time.) 

**Logline: **

**Looking for a fun retreat, a group of dysfunctional friends go up to their childhood cabin, but are faced with a terrifying creature instead. **

**Shoots in: Fairplay, Colorado**

Shoot Dates: December 10th-13th 

Non Union 

Gas Stipend provided - $45 Per Car. 

IMDB credit and planned festival run 

Lodging and Food will be provided! 

Cast is welcome to stay in the cabin over the shooting period to cut down on commute.

**Callbacks will be held over zoom on Saturday October 10th at 12PM**

**MUST BE 18+ TO APPLY **

**Please email headshot, resume, and self tape to ****raidenskaoticfilmss@gmail.com**

Find the Sides here: [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1IIbf2Z78HgSVqVQsZoCfD21dgtJGzPKr?usp=drive_link](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1IIbf2Z78HgSVqVQsZoCfD21dgtJGzPKr?usp=drive_link)

items.text:
**Title: Grandma's Back**

**Genre: ***Comedy, Family Drama*

**Logline: **Susannah must keep herself and her family together when the sudden reanimation of her late mother throws their lives into chaos.

**Roles:**

**Susannah **- *LEAD - Female, 35-55*

Loving and neurotic mother of two recently grieving the death of her own mother. Constantly striving towards success and stability. Despite her best efforts to do what’s best for her daughter and be the mom she always wanted, her attempts often have the opposite effect, only pushing her daughter further away.

**Tess **- *Lead - Female, 14-22*

The defiant eldest of the family.  Artistic and goth, Tess marches to the beat of her own drum, and holds an inner confidence that is bizzare to Susannah. All she wants is for her mom to recognize her spark, and not control her so tightly.

**Grandma **- *Lead - Female, 60-80*

An old fashioned stern woman, who's decided its her way or the highway. Raising Susannah on strict morales, she's left a lasting impact on the generations of her family.

**Greg** - *Supporting - Male, 35-55*

Despite him being quite useless, he is the emotional anchor of the family. Although he may not know exactly what's going on, or what to say, he will always know how to comfort the ones he loves.

**Steven** - *Supporting - Male, 5-12*

The youngest of the family. He is a bothersome little brother and a lovable son. His pastimes consist mainly of irritating his big sister Tess and living in crippling fear of vampires.

**Young Susannah** - *Supporting - Female, 5-12*

Susannah as a child. Very small role. 

**Young Grandma** - *Supporting - Female, 35-55*

Grandma as a young mother. Very small role. 

**Scholarship Committee Members** - *Supporting - All Genders, 35-70*

Unamused and stone faced. The only thing standing between Tess and her Scholarship. Not a speaking role. 

**Art Gallery Extras** - *All Genders, 15-70*

attendees of the gallery

**Director**: Sophii Sherman, Christine Galvez

**Producer: **Dominic Spacone

**Production Type**: Short Film

**Contact Information**: Daspacone@gmail.com

**Run Time**: 10-12 minutes

**Compensation**: Unpaid - Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner provided

**Union Status**: Non-Union

**Audition Information - **

**IN-PERSON AUDITIONS:** We will reach out with further information

**SELF TAPE AUDITIONS**: Email with interest and I will send you sides to audition with - Daspacone@gmail.com

**Shooting Schedule**: September 26th, October 24th,25th, November 6-8th

**Filming Location**: Boulder/Denver area

**Note: **Not all actors needed all days

Hi All
We are filming a Comedy T.V spec pilot this Monday 14th September in the West London area and we are looking for Supporting Artists of any gender or age to play background in a pub scene. 

As we are a self funded small independent production this is not a payed opportunity we will cover food and travel and can offer a named credit to go on your spotlight and IMDb 

We know this isn’t idea for many but for some that are just starting out this is a great opportunity to get on set and get some experience. 

If this is of interest to you please message me directly. 

Thank you 

Josh

topComments.text: Indeed background is not considered as credits on spotlight or IMDB I’m afraid.

Supporting artists are not Spotlight credits, they accept paid theatres or tv acting roles not background work unfortunately Josh Witcher though actual acting roles paid or unpaid self funded student films  can be credited on Spotlight

items.text:
Reels-Darsteller/in für Food & Social Media Content gesucht | Nebenjob / Freelance | Wien

Wir suchen Verstärkung für unser Content-Team! 
Für regelmäßige Social-Media-Produktionen im Bereich Food, Restaurants & Gastronomie suchen wir eine sympathische, zuverlässige und kamerafreudige Person, die unser Team ca. 1 Tag pro Woche unterstützt.

Deine Aufgaben:
🎥 Mitwirkung als Haupt- oder Nebenrolle in Reels & Social-Media-Videos
🎭 Natürliches und authentisches Auftreten vor der Kamera
🎬 Bei Bedarf Kamera/Smartphone bedienen und andere Personen filmen
🎥 Idealerweise auch Unterstützung bei Regie, Kamerawinkeln und Ablauf der Aufnahmen
💡 Eigene Ideen und kreativer Input sind sehr willkommen

Das solltest du mitbringen:
Sympathisches, natürliches gepflegtes und positives Auftreten
Keine Scheu vor Kamera oder vorgegebenen Scripts
Sicherer Umgang mit Smartphone & moderner Technik
Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen
Zuverlässigkeit und Flexibilität
Erfahrung mit Kamera, Social Media, Reels oder Content Creation ist ein großer Vorteil
Erfahrung als Darsteller/in oder mit Regie/Kamera ebenfalls von Vorteil

Was wir bieten:
Stundenlohn – Höhe wird je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation persönlich vereinbart
Essen während der Produktion
Unbegrenzte Getränke während der Produktion
Regelmäßige Zusammenarbeit / ca. 1 Tag pro Woche
Mitarbeit an unterschiedlichen kreativen Projekten im Bereich Food & Social Media
Ein lockeres, kreatives Arbeitsumfeld

📍 Einsatzort: Wien & Umgebung

Not everything that shines is meant to guide you.

After confronting the darkness within herself, Visionarie is approached by a mysterious presence offering everything she has been searching for  success, peace, power, and the life she believes she deserves.

But something about this new light doesn't feel right.

As beautiful promises begin turning into disturbing truths, Visionarie must learn one of her most important lessons yet: sometimes darkness doesn't come looking like darkness. Sometimes it comes looking like everything you prayed for.

And just when Visionarie believes the danger has passed… someone new arrives.

VISIONARIE: THE FALSE LIGHT
A supernatural psychological animated series from The Real Cookiemix Network.

✨ Some visions are warnings.

items.text:
🎬🔥 𝗖𝗔𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗖𝗔𝗟𝗟 — 𝗙𝗟𝗢𝗥𝗜𝗗𝗔 & 𝗦𝗨𝗥𝗥𝗢𝗨𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗧𝗘𝗦 🔥🎬

            ⚔️ 𝗗 𝗘 𝗙 𝗜 𝗔 𝗡 𝗖 𝗘 ⚔️
💥 𝗡𝗢𝗡-𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗢𝗡 • 𝗣𝗔𝗜𝗗 𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗘𝗦 🎥
 𝗙𝗜𝗟𝗠𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗜𝗡 𝗙𝗟𝗢𝗥𝗜𝗗𝗔 • 𝗝𝗔𝗡𝗨𝗔𝗥𝗬 29 – 𝗙𝗘𝗕𝗥𝗨𝗔𝗥𝗬 17, 2027

🎥 𝟯 𝗥𝗔𝗧𝗦 𝗘𝗡𝗧𝗘𝗥𝗧𝗔𝗜𝗡𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗧 🎬 
From the filmmakers behind 𝗞𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗿 𝗚𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗶𝗲𝘀, 𝗕𝗮𝗱 𝗕𝘂𝗻𝗻𝘆, 𝗘𝘅𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗧𝗵𝘂𝗴𝘀, 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗔𝗺𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗻 𝗥𝗶𝗽𝗽𝗲𝗿, 𝗦𝗻𝗮𝗿𝗹𝘆 𝗬𝗼𝘄, and 𝗔𝗺𝗶𝘁𝘆𝘃𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗲: 𝗠𝘁. 𝗠𝗶𝘀𝗲𝗿𝘆 𝗥𝗼𝗮𝗱 comes an ambitious new historical motion picture:

       🔥⚔️ 𝗗 𝗘 𝗙 𝗜 𝗔 𝗡 𝗖 𝗘 ⚔️🔥
𝗙𝗟𝗢𝗥𝗜𝗗𝗔 — 𝗗𝗘𝗖𝗘𝗠𝗕𝗘𝗥 28, 1835
Major Francis L. Dade and his command march deep into the Florida wilderness.
More than 100 U.S. soldiers are making their way north toward Fort King through an unforgiving frontier of pine forests, swamps and dense saw palmettos.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝘆 𝗱𝗼𝗻'𝘁 𝗸𝗻𝗼𝘄 𝗶𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗦𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗿𝗶𝗼𝗿𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝘄𝗮𝘁𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗶𝗿 𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆 𝗺𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁.

Hidden within the Florida wilderness, a resistance is waiting.
Within hours, their march will erupt into one of the most dramatic and consequential battles in Florida history, an event that would help ignite the Second Seminole War and forever change the history of Florida.
Nearly 200 years later, 𝟯 𝗥𝗮𝘁𝘀 𝗘𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 is bringing this extraordinary story to the screen.
🎬 
🔥 𝗪𝗘 𝗔𝗥𝗘 𝗦𝗘𝗘𝗞𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗚𝗘𝗡𝗢𝗨𝗦 𝗔𝗖𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗦, 𝗥𝗘𝗘𝗡𝗔𝗖𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗦 & 𝗣𝗘𝗥𝗙𝗢𝗥𝗠𝗘𝗥𝗦 🔥
We are searching throughout 𝗙𝗹𝗼𝗿𝗶𝗱𝗮 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀 for talented Indigenous performers who can authentically portray the Seminole and Black Seminole warriors and historical figures at the heart of 𝗗𝗘𝗙𝗜𝗔𝗡𝗖𝗘.
⚔️ 𝗠𝗔𝗝𝗢𝗥 𝗛𝗜𝗦𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗜𝗖𝗔𝗟 𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗘𝗦 𝗡𝗢𝗪 𝗖𝗔𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗡𝗚 ⚔️
🔥 𝗠𝗜𝗖𝗔𝗡𝗢𝗣𝗬 🔥 𝗢𝗦𝗖𝗘𝗢𝗟𝗔 🔥 𝗔𝗟𝗟𝗜𝗚𝗔𝗧𝗢𝗥 🔥 𝗔𝗕𝗥𝗔𝗛𝗔𝗠
Plus additional historical figures and 𝗳𝗲𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗦𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗿𝗶𝗼𝗿 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲𝘀.
We are looking for performers with 𝗽𝗼𝘄𝗲𝗿𝗳𝘂𝗹 𝘀𝗰𝗿𝗲𝗲𝗻 𝗽𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲, 𝗮𝘂𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗲𝗿 who can bring these remarkable historical figures to life.
Experience with period flintlock muskets, historical reenactment, horseback riding, wilderness skills or combat performance is a major plus.

     ✔️ 🎬 𝗛𝗢𝗪 𝗧𝗢 𝗦𝗨𝗕𝗠𝗜𝗧 🎬
Please send your submission to:
𝗞𝗔𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗜𝗡𝗔 & 𝗙𝗟𝗢𝗥 𝗖𝗔𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗗𝗜𝗥𝗘𝗖𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗦 — 𝟯 𝗥𝗔𝗧𝗦 𝗘𝗡𝗧𝗘𝗥𝗧𝗔𝗜𝗡𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗧

📧 𝟯𝗿𝗮𝘁𝘀𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁@𝗴𝗺𝗮𝗶𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
Please include:
📸 Several current photographs 🎭 Acting or reenactment experience 🎬 Film credits, if applicable 🔥 Flintlock musket experience, if applicable 🐎 Horseback riding experience, if applicable 📍 Your current city and state

🔥🔥 𝗣𝗟𝗘𝗔𝗦𝗘 𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗥𝗘 𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗦 𝗖𝗔𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗖𝗔𝗟𝗟! 🔥🔥
We are searching Florida and the surrounding states for talented Indigenous actors and performers who have the 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸, 𝗽𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗽𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻 to help bring this extraordinary chapter of history to life.

⚔️ 𝗔 𝗯𝗮𝘁𝘁𝗹𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲𝗱 𝗙𝗹𝗼𝗿𝗶𝗱𝗮 𝗵𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘆. ⚔️ 𝗔 𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘆 𝗻𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗹𝘆 200 𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀 𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴. 🎬 𝗡𝗼𝘄 𝗶𝘁 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗯𝗲 𝗯𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝗰𝗿𝗲𝗲𝗻.

🔥⚔️ 𝗗 𝗘 𝗙 𝗜 𝗔 𝗡 𝗖 𝗘 ⚔️🔥
🎥 𝟯 𝗥𝗔𝗧𝗦 𝗘𝗡𝗧𝗘𝗥𝗧𝗔𝗜𝗡𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗧

🔥 𝗪𝗘 𝗔𝗥𝗘 𝗦𝗘𝗘𝗞𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗚𝗘𝗡𝗢𝗨𝗦 𝗔𝗖𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗦, 𝗥𝗘𝗘𝗡𝗔𝗖𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗦 & 𝗣𝗘𝗥𝗙𝗢𝗥𝗠𝗘𝗥𝗦 🔥
We are searching throughout 𝗙𝗹𝗼𝗿𝗶𝗱𝗮 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀 for talented Indigenous performers who can authentically portray the Seminole and Black Seminole warriors and historical figures at the heart of 𝗗𝗘𝗙𝗜𝗔𝗡𝗖𝗘.

Plus additional historical figures and 𝗳𝗲𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗦𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗿𝗶𝗼𝗿 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲𝘀.

Experience with period flintlock muskets, historical reenactment, horseback riding, wilderness skills or combat performance is a major plus.

CREW CALL: Low-budget independent documentary / educational film

"The Better Body Starter Kit For Men" is a feature-length documentary on the subject of men's fitness, including actual teaching content, so that viewers will be not only motivated to take their fitness seriously, but will have the tools to get started as well.  This listing is for ONE scene, a teaching module identifying the groupings of muscle on the male body for the purpose of organizing more effective workouts.

TITLE & TYPE: "The Better Body Starter Kit For Men" / Feature Film, Documentary, Educational

CREW: Cinematographer [Glorified Camera Operator]
- Production Assistant

LOCATION: Prineville, Oregon, USA

TIME: Saturday, September 19, 2026
8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (or earlier if we finish earlier)

COMPENSATION: Cinematographer: $200
- Production Assistant: $100
- Lunch provided
- Funded by my own work paychecks so Compensation may be delayed but IS guaranteed.  [This is my first attempt at a feature film; the last thing I want is a bad reputation at the very beginning.]
- Not a union shoot

APPLYING: For Cinematographer, please include a reel or demo or YouTube channel - any proof that you have experience and I won't be training someone who's never framed up a good shot of film.
- All applications ASAP as the shoot is 10 days away.
- The scene will be focused on a male model stripped down to a speedo for visibility of all the muscle groups; applicants should be comfortable filming this.  (At no time will the model be naked; content is academic in tone, non-sexual.)

CONTACT: Brian Johnson
- bigtigerproductions@outlook.com

OPEN CASTING CALL — TALARIQ

Production: The Buzzer
Format: Stage Play
Production Company: Conundrum Theatre Company
Location: Burbank, CA

We are seeking a young male actor to portray Talariq, a teenage boy in the foster care system, for an upcoming production of The Buzzer, a new original play by Chandra Thomas.

TALARIQ:
A teenager navigating the foster care system. Talariq is intelligent, observant, and emotionally complex. The role requires an actor who can bring authenticity, vulnerability, and strong emotional presence to the stage.

REHEARSALS:
Weeknights, 7:00 PM–10:00 PM
Burbank, CA

TECH: September 13
PERFORMANCES: September 20 & September 26
VENUE: Victory Theatre Center, Burbank

COMPENSATION: Volunteer / Unpaid

AUDITION:
Actors interested in the role should submit their headshot, résumé, and a brief introduction. Selected actors will receive audition materials and further information.

We are looking for an actor who is committed, collaborative, and excited to be part of an original theatrical production.

To submit: email:

titustelge@gmail.com 

Go to this audition form link
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeJ8jnGLlEuXvsSpAbh5Bx3otf4p_b509Dp5vZ4EUuHodhRUg/viewform?usp=header

We look forward to seeing your work!

Actors!

It's that time again:) 

My question is, what if everything got easier by being more of who you are? This year, how about not trying to get everything right, and lead with hope/have more fun instead!

Everything starts with a free 20 minute consult. Head to [https://www.gabriellevey.com/grad-school-auditions](https://www.gabriellevey.com/grad-school-auditions) for more information and contact info.

sharedPost.text:
NOW ACCEPTING NEW CLIENTS FOR BFA/MFA AUDITION COACHING
 
Head to www.gabriellevey.com learn more/book your first session!

Auditioning for BFA/MFA programs can be one of the more stressful days in a young actor’s life. It can also be one of the most incredibly satisfying, impactful, and exhilarating! I work with my clients to help them shine in ways that feel singularly authentic, while staying open to any and all possibilities that arise moment to moment.

Who it’s for:
My ideal clients are curious and playful, motivated and courageous. If you’re open to the creative process and ready to step outside your comfort zone, let’s work together to build the skills that will help you feel your best, share your full self, and ace auditions.

How it works:
For BFA and MFA programs, you’re not auditioning for a role, you’re auditioning for a spot in a dynamic ensemble of actors who will be training together for 2 to 4 years. The most important thing is for the jurors to see YOU and everything that you, and only you can bring to the room. And we see the most of you when you are unabashedly having fun and playing with abandon. For this reason it is critical that we find material that you LOVE and will be thrilled to share on the day of the audition.

I help clients:
•choose audition materials that light you up
•rehearse those materials to draw out and physicalize a character’s nuanced traits and motivations
•find and cultivate the fun in your work and the pleasure of performance in a high pressure environment

Successful outcomes:
As a graduate of Boston University and the David Geffen School of Drama at Yale, I have first hand experience with successful BFA and MFA auditions. And, after years of coaching I have developed a unique process built for success. In addition to a wide range of BFA/MFA programs in the US, I understand the British BFA/MFA circuit particularly well.
 
My clients have landed spots at:
•David Geffen School of Drama at Yale
•Juilliard
•NYU
•Brown/Trinity Rep
•Columbia
•UCSD
•RADA (UK)
•Guildhall (UK)
•LAMDA (UK)
•Central School of Speech and Drama (UK)
•Many, many more

sharedPost.text:
🌀🎬🎥🌚 Exclusive Acting Workshop – Final Version .version A.

💡 Value Highlight: Learn directly from a DP/Director whose professional rate is $1,500/day 

this 4-session online workshop gives you real film-level expertise at a fraction of that cost!
Price on enquiry.

VERY LOW COST: One-on-One Online via Skype
"This course integrates the poetic realism of Tarkovsky, the practical wisdom of Michael Caine, and the transformative techniques of Stanislavski and Method Acting. Designed to deepen your craft, it focuses on authentic emotional connection and powerful storytelling."

🎬 Created by a British Cinematographer/Director with 31 Years of Experience and 32 Features to His Name
🌐 International Experience: Having worked on films worldwide, collaborating with actors and directors, I bring real-world insights from both sides of the camera. This course is designed to give actors a deep understanding of their craft, emphasizing emotional depth and character development.

🌐 IMDb: www.imdb.com/name/nm1806508

🌐 Showreel: https://enkiproductions1.8b.io

🤔 What You Will Learn:

🌀 Emotional Range: Master the ability to express a full spectrum of emotions, making your performances more believable and compelling.

🌀 Character Development: Create rich, multidimensional characters by exploring their internal world, external actions, and backstory.

🌀 Method Acting: Use personal experiences and emotions to deliver raw, authentic performances.

🌀 Working with Directors and Crew: Learn how to hit marks, understand shooting ratios, and collaborate with crew members to enhance your performance.

🌀 Scene Preparation: Techniques for script interpretation, emotional connection, and performing under pressure.

🌀 Industry Standards: How to create a professional showreel and work effectively with casting directors and filmmakers.
🎬 Day 1: Moment-to-Moment Acting (Stanislavski’s Approach).

🔹 Breaking a Scene Down: The use of internal visualization and meditation to "become" the character.

Character Exercise: The Hitman’s First Kill
📍 Scene: A low-rent hotel room in Manhattan, lit by a dull winter’s midday light. The sad hum of a ceiling fan, distant sirens, muted traffic below. On the bed—a brand-new sniper rifle.

🔹 Exercise 1 (Singular Emotion): Enter the room, pick up the gun, examine it, and prepare for the target. Remain fully in character.

🔹 Exercise 2 (Multiple Emotional Shifts):
Enter slightly out of breath, feeling relief—"I made it here. No one saw me."
The weight of reality sets in—"Am I really about to kill someone?"
Mesmerized by the artistry of the gun—draw on memories of seeing/touching weapons.
Snapped back to reality by a siren—trace the feeling of waking from a dream.
Decision made—move to the window, set up the gun, and wait.

🔹 Discussion: How do actors like Heath Ledger, Daniel Day-Lewis, and Dustin Hoffman make their characters so real? Insights from my own experiences on set with actors who never broke character—even during dinner.

Exercise 3 (If Time Allows): The Phone Call
📍 Scene: You’ve done something terrible—enough to make the person you love most leave forever. You must convince them to stay.

🎭 Goal: Improvise, using pure emotional truth, until the performance is undeniably real.

🎬 Day 2: Making Your Character Believable
🔹 Understanding the Psyche: Whether playing a killer or an ordinary person, you must know your character’s mind.

Character Exercise: The Breaking Point
📍 Scene: A crowded supermarket. A tired voice announces deals over the PA. You feel unseen, unheard, frustrated—until suddenly, you’re holding an AK-47. (Note: These scenes are purely acting exercises. They can be altered if a student is uncomfortable.)

🔹 Alternative Scene: A character about to detonate a bomb, written in the style of Heath Ledger’s Joker.

🔹 Alternative Scene: A video call to the person you love most—telling them why. (Scripted or improv.)

📍 Final Monologue Exercise: "Hi everyone… Tomorrow’s going to be different." The last words before an irreversible decision

🔹 Accents: Versatility in performance—working with British, American (Deep South), and Northern Irish accents.

🔹 Final Exercise: The Power of Stillness—sit before the camera, smiling, at total peace. Convey pure serenity.

🎬 Day 3: Working with a Director and Crew
🔹 Understanding Your Role: How an actor fits into the filmmaking process.

🔹 Hitting Marks & Lighting: The technical side of making performances shine.

🔹 Shooting Ratios: How they affect your performance.

🔹 Crew Collaboration: Understanding continuity, sound, makeup, cinematography, and direction.
Final Showreel Scenes (Day 3):

🎭 Sinister: "So you really think you got away with it? You really think that?" (Improv)

🎭 Heartbroken: "But I didn’t mean it... please, please, don’t leave me…" (Improv)

🎭 Insane (Joker-like): "Mmm... if E = mc², then time versus chaos... who cares?" (Improv)

🎭 Flat & Emotionless: "We’re born, we live, we die. That’s it." (Improv)
🔹 Goal: Draw from personal experiences and trace memories to make the performances deeply real.

🎬 Day 4: Fear and Survival – Personal Experience & Character Creation

🔹 Deep Dive: Exploring fear, survival, and desperation in character work.

Exercise 1: The Jungle Escape
📍 Scene: You’re lost in the jungle at night, exhausted, your breath the only sound. Every step is agony, but stopping means death. You call out—pleading for help. No answer.

🎭 Emotions to Explore:
Fear of death – the realization that no one is coming.
Desperation – the raw instinct to survive.
Physical exhaustion – feeling your body give in.

🎭 Method Process:
Internal Visualization – Close your eyes, hear the insects, the rustling leaves, your pounding heartbeat.

Personal Connection – Recall a moment when you felt completely lost or afraid.
Scene Execution – Let the emotions guide your body and voice.

Exercise 2: The Phone Call Redux
📍 Scene: You’re on the phone with a loved one. You need their help. If they refuse, it’s over. What do you say? What do you leave out?

🎭 Objective: Make the desperation feel real. This is life or death.

Final Performance (Day 4):
Students will perform a final emotional scene, bringing together everything they’ve learned. These performances will be recorded as raw material for their showreel.

🎬🎥 Ready to Elevate Your Acting?
This isn’t just a class—it’s an intense, immersive experience that will change the way you act forever.

🌐 To Enroll: p.m.me or e.mail:

🎬 INDUSTRY OPPORTUNITIES…
WHAT’S NEXT?

Hi everyone! I’m currently looking to take the next step in my career and would love to connect with people across the industry who may have opportunities, contacts or recommendations within their networks.

I have experience both on and off screen, including national television, Netflix credits, and winning a TV series in 2025. I’ve also worked across live performance, music and public speaking, performing and speaking to audiences ranging from around 100 people to crowds of 20,000.

On the commercial side, I’ve worked on campaigns and content for brands including HOKA, Wenzel’s, Aussie Hair Care, BYD, and others… with features in The sun, Cosmopolitan, Highsnobiety  and many more! 
both through productions and independently, including self-shooting and creating myself.

I’m also able to bring production capabilities to the table. I have professional cameras and drone equipment, as well as an industry standard studio for sound production and voiceover work, so I’m comfortable being both in front of and behind the camera.

At this point, I’m genuinely open to exploring where the next opportunity could take me.
🎥 Film & TV
🎭 Theatre & live performance
📺 Presenting / broadcasting
🎤 Events, launches & public speaking
🎬 Production / content creation
🎙️ Voiceover & sound
📸 Commercials & advertising
📱 Digital / social content
🤝 Management / representation
📣 PR & brand opportunities
…and anything else where you think I could be a good fit.

If you’re a casting director, agent, manager, producer, production company, PR professional, executive, creative, or simply someone with a connection who thinks we should speak, I’d love to hear from you!
I’m ready to work, happy to travel globally for the right role (I am based in London), and very open to getting creative and excited about what comes next.

If you have an opportunity, recommendation, introduction or even just a contact you think I should speak to, please drop me a DM or comment below and I’ll get in touch.
Thanks in advance! 
Genuinely appreciate anyone who can point me in the right direction. 🙏

#Casting #CastingCall #Actors #Acting #FilmAndTV #Television #Theatre #Presenter #Voiceover #Production #Commercials #Talent #EntertainmentIndustry  #CreativeIndustry

At this point, I’m genuinely open to exploring where the next opportunity could take me.

📺 Presenting / broadcasting
🎤 Events, launches & public speaking
🎬 Production / content creation
🎙️ Voiceover & sound
📸 Commercials & advertising
📱 Digital / social content
🤝 Management / representation
📣 PR & brand opportunities
…and anything else where you think I could be a good fit.

If you’re a casting director, agent, manager, producer, production company, PR professional, executive, creative, or simply someone with a connection who thinks we should speak, I’d love to hear from you!
I’m ready to work, happy to travel globally for the right role (I am based in London), and very open to getting creative and excited about what comes next.

If you have an opportunity, recommendation, introduction or even just a contact you think I should speak to, please drop me a DM or comment below and I’ll get in touch.

Genuinely appreciate anyone who can point me in the right direction. 🙏

sharedPost.text:
🌀🎬🎥🌚 Exclusive Acting Workshop – Final Version .version A.

💡 Value Highlight: Learn directly from a DP/Director whose professional rate is $1,500/day 

this 4-session online workshop gives you real film-level expertise at a fraction of that cost!
Price on enquiry.

VERY LOW COST: One-on-One Online via Skype
"This course integrates the poetic realism of Tarkovsky, the practical wisdom of Michael Caine, and the transformative techniques of Stanislavski and Method Acting. Designed to deepen your craft, it focuses on authentic emotional connection and powerful storytelling."

🎬 Created by a British Cinematographer/Director with 31 Years of Experience and 32 Features to His Name
🌐 International Experience: Having worked on films worldwide, collaborating with actors and directors, I bring real-world insights from both sides of the camera. This course is designed to give actors a deep understanding of their craft, emphasizing emotional depth and character development.

🌐 IMDb: www.imdb.com/name/nm1806508

🌐 Showreel: https://enkiproductions1.8b.io

🤔 What You Will Learn:

🌀 Emotional Range: Master the ability to express a full spectrum of emotions, making your performances more believable and compelling.

🌀 Character Development: Create rich, multidimensional characters by exploring their internal world, external actions, and backstory.

🌀 Method Acting: Use personal experiences and emotions to deliver raw, authentic performances.

🌀 Working with Directors and Crew: Learn how to hit marks, understand shooting ratios, and collaborate with crew members to enhance your performance.

🌀 Scene Preparation: Techniques for script interpretation, emotional connection, and performing under pressure.

🌀 Industry Standards: How to create a professional showreel and work effectively with casting directors and filmmakers.
🎬 Day 1: Moment-to-Moment Acting (Stanislavski’s Approach).

🔹 Breaking a Scene Down: The use of internal visualization and meditation to "become" the character.

Character Exercise: The Hitman’s First Kill
📍 Scene: A low-rent hotel room in Manhattan, lit by a dull winter’s midday light. The sad hum of a ceiling fan, distant sirens, muted traffic below. On the bed—a brand-new sniper rifle.

🔹 Exercise 1 (Singular Emotion): Enter the room, pick up the gun, examine it, and prepare for the target. Remain fully in character.

🔹 Exercise 2 (Multiple Emotional Shifts):
Enter slightly out of breath, feeling relief—"I made it here. No one saw me."
The weight of reality sets in—"Am I really about to kill someone?"
Mesmerized by the artistry of the gun—draw on memories of seeing/touching weapons.
Snapped back to reality by a siren—trace the feeling of waking from a dream.
Decision made—move to the window, set up the gun, and wait.

🔹 Discussion: How do actors like Heath Ledger, Daniel Day-Lewis, and Dustin Hoffman make their characters so real? Insights from my own experiences on set with actors who never broke character—even during dinner.

Exercise 3 (If Time Allows): The Phone Call
📍 Scene: You’ve done something terrible—enough to make the person you love most leave forever. You must convince them to stay.

🎭 Goal: Improvise, using pure emotional truth, until the performance is undeniably real.

🎬 Day 2: Making Your Character Believable
🔹 Understanding the Psyche: Whether playing a killer or an ordinary person, you must know your character’s mind.

Character Exercise: The Breaking Point
📍 Scene: A crowded supermarket. A tired voice announces deals over the PA. You feel unseen, unheard, frustrated—until suddenly, you’re holding an AK-47. (Note: These scenes are purely acting exercises. They can be altered if a student is uncomfortable.)

🔹 Alternative Scene: A character about to detonate a bomb, written in the style of Heath Ledger’s Joker.

🔹 Alternative Scene: A video call to the person you love most—telling them why. (Scripted or improv.)

📍 Final Monologue Exercise: "Hi everyone… Tomorrow’s going to be different." The last words before an irreversible decision

🔹 Accents: Versatility in performance—working with British, American (Deep South), and Northern Irish accents.

🔹 Final Exercise: The Power of Stillness—sit before the camera, smiling, at total peace. Convey pure serenity.

🎬 Day 3: Working with a Director and Crew
🔹 Understanding Your Role: How an actor fits into the filmmaking process.

🔹 Hitting Marks & Lighting: The technical side of making performances shine.

🔹 Shooting Ratios: How they affect your performance.

🔹 Crew Collaboration: Understanding continuity, sound, makeup, cinematography, and direction.
Final Showreel Scenes (Day 3):

🎭 Sinister: "So you really think you got away with it? You really think that?" (Improv)

🎭 Heartbroken: "But I didn’t mean it... please, please, don’t leave me…" (Improv)

🎭 Insane (Joker-like): "Mmm... if E = mc², then time versus chaos... who cares?" (Improv)

🎭 Flat & Emotionless: "We’re born, we live, we die. That’s it." (Improv)
🔹 Goal: Draw from personal experiences and trace memories to make the performances deeply real.

🎬 Day 4: Fear and Survival – Personal Experience & Character Creation

🔹 Deep Dive: Exploring fear, survival, and desperation in character work.

Exercise 1: The Jungle Escape
📍 Scene: You’re lost in the jungle at night, exhausted, your breath the only sound. Every step is agony, but stopping means death. You call out—pleading for help. No answer.

🎭 Emotions to Explore:
Fear of death – the realization that no one is coming.
Desperation – the raw instinct to survive.
Physical exhaustion – feeling your body give in.

🎭 Method Process:
Internal Visualization – Close your eyes, hear the insects, the rustling leaves, your pounding heartbeat.

Personal Connection – Recall a moment when you felt completely lost or afraid.
Scene Execution – Let the emotions guide your body and voice.

Exercise 2: The Phone Call Redux
📍 Scene: You’re on the phone with a loved one. You need their help. If they refuse, it’s over. What do you say? What do you leave out?

🎭 Objective: Make the desperation feel real. This is life or death.

Final Performance (Day 4):
Students will perform a final emotional scene, bringing together everything they’ve learned. These performances will be recorded as raw material for their showreel.

🎬🎥 Ready to Elevate Your Acting?
This isn’t just a class—it’s an intense, immersive experience that will change the way you act forever.

🌐 To Enroll: p.m.me or e.mail:
mikeenkiproductions1@gmail.com
Let’s create something unforgettable.

I’m trying to help cast teens (ages 12–17) for a b-roll shoot for Edgeline Films' upcoming documentary, The Anxious Generation, exploring how phones and social media have changed childhood and adolescence. The film will premiere on a streamer next year! 

The Details: 

Filming: Sunday, Sept 13th, 10am–6pm in south slope, Brooklyn. We only need a one or two hour window — happy to work around your teen's schedule.

What we're shooting: Stylized, cinematic shots of teens on phones -- scrolling through social media, macro shots of eyes as they scroll, hands swiping, and other candid glimpses of everyday life growing up with smartphones. 

No acting or speaking experience needed — just teens who are open to being on camera (and hanging out on a fun set!). 

If you know anyone who might be open to participating, please have them fill out this form 

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf-KU_Mw_Ca8I4EHJzzh9NnEHxOb2lKP-SfIbkUdWrBR6uqTA/viewform

and our producer Sophie will reach out

CASTING CALL: CAN YOU PLAY A YOUNG ALFRED HINKEL?

We’re looking for someone with attitude. Opinions. Confidence. And preferably no shortage of any of them.

 

For more than 20 years, filmmaker Georgia Court has been documenting the extraordinary lives and work of Alfred Hinkel and John Linden. Now, as the documentary moves towards completion, several moments from their younger years are being brought back to life through dramatic re-enactments.

YOUNG ALFRED HINKEL

Young Alfred is opinionated, arrogant, charismatic, uncompromising and absolutely convinced he knows what he’s doing — even when everyone around him might have a different opinion.

Sound like someone you could play?

The film travels through Alfred’s younger years — from hitchhiking into O’Kiep, teaching his first dance classes in the 1970s and driving around in his Volksie, to the early days of Jazzart, the streets and dance culture of 1980s Cape Town, and eventually walking into CAPAB in the 1990s.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

The actor must:

• Hold a valid driver’s licence and be comfortable driving for filming

• Be comfortable portraying a gay man — there are no overly affectionate scenes

• Be comfortable acting with a cigarette and portraying Alfred as a smoker

• Be available for rehearsals and filming in O’Kiep and Cape Town

 

OPEN CASTING CALL

Applicants must submit:

• Headshot

• Date of birth

• Height

• Clothing sizes

• City/Town of residence

Send your application to: info@georgiacourt.co.za

 

 

 

PROPOSED SCHEDULE (TBC)

September: Cape Town auditions – one day within this period, date TBC

Mid - Late October: Rehearsals & Shooting in Northern Cape & Cape Town 

 

THE SEARCH FOR YOUNG ALFRED IS ON!

CASTING CALL — POPO!
We’re looking for people interested in being part of a new comedy show/short film called “POPO,” a parody inspired by the style of COPS.

Location: Peninsula, Ohio

Filming begins TOMORROW and continues throughout this month

We’re currently looking for:

SUSPECTS — People willing to play ridiculous, funny, or suspicious characters.

WITNESSES — People who can give funny “interviews” and tell their side of the story.

DISPATCHERS — Potential voice-over roles for dispatch calls.

BYSTANDERS — People appearing naturally in the background or reacting to what’s happening.

COMEDIC CHARACTERS — Various funny and unusual characters throughout the show.

EXTRAS — Anyone who wants to be part of the scenes and help bring the world of POPO to life.

No professional acting experience is necessary. If you can improvise, have a sense of humor, or just want to try something different, we’d love to have you.

The idea is to make it feel like a serious police reality show while everything around the “officers” is completely ridiculous.

If you’re interested in participating, comment below or send me a message and let me know what type of role you’d be interested in.

POPO — Because somebody has to patrol Peninsula.

Message my account if interested.

CASTING CALL | LOS ANGELES/BURBANK AREA.
THE BODY BETWEEN US | NYFA STUDENT SHORT FILM

Hi everyone! I’m Federica, a casting director and the founder of FC Casting Studio. While I normally work on paid projects, I’m volunteering my casting services to help a friend with her NYFA student film, The Body Between Us.

This is an unpaid project. Meals, IMDb credit, footage for your reel, and reimbursement for transportation expenses will be provided.

Location: Los Angeles, CA
Tentative filming dates: Late October / early November 2026
First auditions: Saturday, September 12, via Zoom
If you can't on Saturday, let me know your availability. 

ABOUT THE FILM
After a wealthy businessman shoots a contractor, he and his wife must contain the evidence and agree on a story before the police arrive.

SEEKING:

EMILY FROST | Female | Playing age 35–40 | Lead
White descent.
An accomplished PR strategist. Intelligent, elegant, and observant, Emily excels at managing people and perception. When a crisis threatens her carefully constructed life, she must decide where her loyalties truly lie.

RICHARD FROST | Male | Playing age 45–50 | Lead
White descent.
A wealthy businessman who is polished, commanding, and charismatic. Accustomed to authority, Richard expects loyalty and resists being challenged. When his world begins to unravel, he becomes determined to control both the situation and the narrative.

RAFAEL ALVAREZ | Male | Playing age 40 | Latino | Supporting
A skilled contractor, husband, and father. Hardworking and proud, Rafael refuses to be intimidated by wealth or status. A financial dispute brings him into conflict with Richard. The role includes portraying a deceased character on screen, with dialogue recorded separately.

TO SUBMIT
Please email your headshot, résumé, and reel, if available, to:

castingdesk@fcsubmissions.com

Subject line: The Body Between Us + Character Name
Example: The Body Between Us Emily Frost

Please include your availability for Saturday’s Zoom auditions. I’ll send the audition sides by email.

Thank you!

🎬 **STATISTER SØGES TIL KIRKEOPTAGELSE (ULØNNET)**

Kortfilmen *IRIS* søger statister i alle aldre til en vigtig bisættelsesscene.

📅 **OPTAGELSESDATOER**

**Fredag d. 18/09**
🕣 Kl. 08.30–13.00

**Søndag d. 20/09**
🕘 Kl. 09.15–15.45

📍 **Vestre Kirkegårds Allé 15, 2450 København SV**

🍽️ **Vi sørger for forplejning!**

🎥 **OM FILMEN**

*IRIS* zoomer ind på tab i en alt for tidlig alder og et ungt menneskes opgør med overbeskyttende forældre.

Scenen foregår til bisættelsen af hovedkarakteren **ALBERTs** bedste veninde, **NAJA**, som mistede livet under et ukontrolleret studentergilde.

🎭 **DIN ROLLE SOM STATIST**

Det er en statistrolle med tilstedeværelse og reaktioner.

Albert afbryder bisættelsen og går akavet op til alteret for at afholde en tale. Jeres reaktioner vil være essentielle for publikums oplevelse af hans handling.

Nogle af jer skal:
• Hviske lidt i krogene
• Grine
• Blive rørt af ærligheden i Alberts ord

👀 Derudover er det under bisættelsen, at et stort plottwist finder sted!

📩 **INTERESSERET?**

Skriv til mig på mail:
**[martinturcot@gmail.com](mailto:martinturcot@gmail.com)**

Du er også meget velkommen til at skrive til mig på PB.

Glæder mig til at høre fra jer! 🙌

**God energi ud til jer alle <3**

Martin Turcot
*Statistkoordinator, IRIS*

THRILLER-MUSICAL: AUDITION I WEEKENDEN!Skuespillere, sangere, dansere og ensemble søges til genopsætningen af Musicalteatrets originale, anmelderroste og storsælgende thrillermusical fra 2019, “JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”, skrevet og instrueret af Rasmus Mansachs (skaberen af bl.a. “Vi maler byen rød: The Musical” og “Jeg tror det kaldes kærlighed: The Musical”). Vil du være med i en seriøs, dramatisk, chokerende, rørende og anderledes dansk teaterproduktion, hvor man bogstaveligt talt kommer helt ud over scenekanten? Tilmeld dig audition hos hovedstadsområdets største musicalforening nu: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op er velkomne, og vi søger især flere tilmeldinger fra mandlige skuespillere og/eller sangere samt dansere af alle køn!

Auditiondato: Lørdag/søndag d. 12.-13. september 2026.
Der søges: Ca. 50 skuespillere, sangere og/eller dansere i alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op (erfaring er ikke et krav) til de 14 bærende roller og ca. 30 personer til ensemblet.
Øveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027.
Øvested: Teaterhuset Borgen på Frederiksberg.
Forestillingsdatoer: 3.-20. marts 2027.
Spillested: Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene i København.
OBS: Det er muligt at tilmelde sig “kun” som danser eller ensemble uden sang/replikker, hvis man ikke ønsker at synge kor eller have replikker i forestillingen.
Musicalteatret er en teaterforening, og det er derfor ulønnet at medvirke på scenen.
Auditiontilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Musicalteatret præsenterer:
“JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”
Instruktør: Rasmus Mansachs
Sanginstruktør/korleder: Johnny Jørgensen
Koreograf: Anne-Cathrine Albæk
Manuskript: Rasmus Mansachs
Originalsange: Lars Rahbek Andresen & Rasmus Mansachs

Læs mere om audition og tilmeld dig her: musicalteatret.dk/audition

sharedPost.text:
THRILLER-MUSICAL: AUDITION I WEEKENDEN!
Skuespillere, sangere, dansere og ensemble søges til genopsætningen af Musicalteatrets originale, anmelderroste og storsælgende thrillermusical fra 2019, “JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”, skrevet og instrueret af Rasmus Mansachs (skaberen af bl.a. “Vi maler byen rød: The Musical” og “Jeg tror det kaldes kærlighed: The Musical”). Vil du være med i en seriøs, dramatisk, chokerende, rørende og anderledes dansk teaterproduktion, hvor man bogstaveligt talt kommer helt ud over scenekanten? Tilmeld dig audition hos hovedstadsområdets største musicalforening nu: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op er velkomne, og vi søger især flere tilmeldinger fra mandlige skuespillere og/eller sangere samt dansere af alle køn!

Auditiondato: Lørdag/søndag d. 12.-13. september 2026.
Der søges: Ca. 50 skuespillere, sangere og/eller dansere i alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op (erfaring er ikke et krav) til de 14 bærende roller og ca. 30 personer til ensemblet.
Øveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027.
Øvested: Teaterhuset Borgen på Frederiksberg.
Forestillingsdatoer: 3.-20. marts 2027.
Spillested: Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene i København.
OBS: Det er muligt at tilmelde sig “kun” som danser eller ensemble uden sang/replikker, hvis man ikke ønsker at synge kor eller have replikker i forestillingen.
Musicalteatret er en teaterforening, og det er derfor ulønnet at medvirke på scenen.
Auditiontilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Musicalteatret præsenterer:
“JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”
Instruktør: Rasmus Mansachs
Sanginstruktør/korleder: Johnny Jørgensen
Koreograf: Anne-Cathrine Albæk
Manuskript: Rasmus Mansachs
Originalsange: Lars Rahbek Andresen & Rasmus Mansachs

Læs mere om audition og tilmeld dig her: musicalteatret.dk/audition
